∀ {a b : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ 2 a →
    ContDiff ℝ 2 b →
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ a →
        ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ b →
          ∀ {p q u : ℝ},
            0 < p →
              0 < q →
                (∀ (t : ℝ),
                    BfgsVerification.RidgeSupersession.profile a b p q u ≤
                      BfgsVerification.RidgeSupersession.profile a b p q t) →
                  (∀ (t : ℝ),
                      BfgsVerification.RidgeSupersession.profile a b p q t =
                          BfgsVerification.RidgeSupersession.profile a b p q u →
                        t = u) →
                    (∀ (t : ℝ), t ≠ u → 0 < deriv (deriv a) t) →
                      (∀ (t : ℝ), t ≠ u → 0 < deriv (deriv b) t) →
                        ∀
                          (R :
                            BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun 2
                              (BfgsVerification.RidgeSupersession.objective a b p q)),
                          Filter.Tendsto (fun k => BfgsVerification.RidgeSupersession.objective a b p q (R.x k))
                              Filter.atTop (𝓝 (BfgsVerification.RidgeSupersession.profile a b p q u)) ∧
                            Filter.Tendsto R.x Filter.atTop (𝓝 (BfgsVerification.RidgeSupersession.optimizer a b p q u))

  (V W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T : BfgsVerification.Mat r) (b : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  W = V * T + BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) b →
    BfgsVerification.metricGram (R.hessian (k + 1)) W =
      Matrix.transpose T *
            (BfgsVerification.metricGram (R.hessian k) V -
              (R.q k)⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer (V.transpose.mulVec (R.g k)) (V.transpose.mulVec (R.g k))) *
          T +
        (R.curvature k)⁻¹ •
          BfgsVerification.outer (W.transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k)) (W.transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k))
